title: GraQle Verifier Keyring
description: The trusted-key manifest a verifier evaluates a bundle's signature against. Explicit per-kid validity windows and lifecycle states let an auditor verify a historical proof under the trust state that applied when it was signed.

_test_only.description: OPTIONAL. When true, this keyring is test/conformance data whose private key is reproducible from a published seed. A conformant deployment MUST NOT load a keyring carrying this marker into a real trust store.

keys.description: Trusted signing keys. A bundle's kid is resolved against this list; a kid that is absent is UNKNOWN_KID, and a kid that is present but not trusted at signed_at is UNTRUSTED_KID.

kid.description: Key identifier matched against the bundle's signature.kid.

public_key_pem.description: PEM-encoded ed25519 PUBLIC key. Only ed25519 keys are accepted; a non-ed25519 key is a usage error, not a verification failure.

valid_from.description: OPTIONAL RFC 3339 start of the trust window. Omitted means open-ended.

valid_until.description: OPTIONAL RFC 3339 end of the trust window. Omitted means open-ended. A bundle whose signed_at falls outside the window is UNTRUSTED_KID.

state.description: Key lifecycle state. Omitted defaults to ACTIVE. REVOKED withdraws trust. RETIRED means the key signs nothing new, but proofs it made earlier still verify - retirement is not revocation.
